name: adaptability
effect: This Pokémon inflicts twice as much damage with moves whose types match its own, rather than the usual same-type attack bonus of 1.5×.
effectEs: Potencia los movimientos del mismo tipo del Pokémon de 1,5× a 2×.

name: aerilate
effect: Turns the bearer's Normal-type moves into Flying-type moves.  Moves changed by this ability have 1.3× their power.
effectEs: Convierte los movimientos de tipo Normal en tipo Volador. Potencia 1,3×.

name: aftermath
effect: When this Pokémon is knocked out by a move that makes contact, the move's user takes 1/4 its maximum HP in damage.
effectEs: Si el Pokémon es debilitado por un movimiento de contacto, el atacante pierde 1/4 de sus PS máximos.

name: air-lock
effect:
While this Pokémon is in battle, weather can still be in play, but will not have any of its effects.

This ability functions identically to Cloud Nine.
effectEs: Elimina los efectos del clima mientras el Pokémon está en combate. Idéntico a Bucle Aire.

name: analytic
effect:
This Pokémon's moves have 1.3× their power when it moves last in a turn.

Future Sight and Doom Desire are unaffected.
effectEs: Si se mueve al último en el turno, sus movimientos tienen 1,3× de potencia. Vista Futura y Deseo Oculto no se ven afectados.

name: anger-point
effect:
Whenever this Pokémon receives a critical hit, its Attack rises to the maximum of 6 stages.

This ability will still take effect if the critical hit is received by a Substitute.
effectEs: Si recibe un golpe crítico, su Ataque sube al máximo (6 niveles).

name: anger-shell
effect: When an attack causes its HP to drop to half or less, the Pokémon gets angry. This lowers its Defense and Sp. Def stats but boosts its Attack, Sp. Atk, and Speed stats.
effectEs: Cuando sus PS bajan a la mitad o menos por un ataque, baja Defensa y Def. Esp. pero sube Ataque, At. Esp. y Velocidad.

name: anticipation
effect:
When this Pokémon enters battle, if one of its opponents has a move that is super effective against it, Self-Destruct, Explosion, or a one-hit knockout move, all participating trainers are notified.

The move itself is not revealed; only that there is such a move.  Moves that inflict typeless damage, such as Future Sight, and moves of variable type, such as Hidden Power, count as their listed types.  Counter, Metal Burst, Mirror Coat, and one-hit KO moves to which this Pokémon is immune do not trigger this ability.
effectEs: Al entrar en combate avisa si el rival tiene un movimiento supereficaz, autodestrucción o KO directo.

name: arena-trap
effect:
While this Pokémon is in battle, opposing Pokémon cannot flee or switch out.  Flying-type Pokémon and Pokémon in the air, e.g. due to Levitate or Magnet Rise, are unaffected.

Pokémon with Run Away can still flee.  Pokémon can still switch out with the use of a move or item.

Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, the wild encounter rate is doubled.
effectEs: Impide que el rival huya o cambie de Pokémon. No afecta a tipo Volador, Levitación o Globo. Duplica encuentros si lidera el equipo.

name: armor-tail
effect: The mysterious tail covering the Pokémon’s head makes opponents unable to use priority moves against the Pokémon or its allies.
effectEs: La misteriosa cola que cubre su cabeza impide que los rivales usen movimientos con prioridad contra él o sus aliados.

name: aroma-veil
effect: Protects allies against moves that affect their mental state.
effectEs: Protege a los aliados de movimientos que afectan su estado mental como Atracción, Mofa o Canto.

name: as-one-glastrier
effect:
This Pokémon has the combined effects of Unnerve and Chilling Neigh.

Opposing Pokémon cannot eat held Berries while this Pokémon is in battle. Affected Pokémon can still use Bug Bite or Pluck to eat a target's Berry.

When this Pokémon knocks out a target, it utters a chilling neigh, which boosts its Attack stat.
effectEs: Combina Nerviosismo y Jinete Gélido. El rival no puede comer bayas. Al debilitar a un objetivo sube el Ataque.

name: as-one-spectrier
effect:
This Pokémon has the combined effects of Unnerve and Grim Neigh.

Opposing Pokémon cannot eat held Berries while this Pokémon is in battle. Affected Pokémon can still use Bug Bite or Pluck to eat a target's Berry.

When this Pokémon knocks out a target, it utters a terrifying neigh, which boosts its Sp. Atk stat.
effectEs: Combina Nerviosismo y Jinete Espectral. El rival no puede comer bayas. Al debilitar a un objetivo sube el At. Esp.

name: aura-break
effect: While this Pokémon is on the field, Dark Aura and Fairy Aura weaken moves of their respective types to 2/3 their power, rather than strengthening them.
effectEs: Invierte las auras: Aura Siniestra y Aura Feérica pasan de potenciar 1,33× a reducir a 2/3.

name: aura-guard
effect: A Pokémon with Aura Guard takes half damage from moves that make contact. Moves affected by Long Reach which make contact will deal regular damage.
effectEs: Reduce a la mitad el daño de movimientos de contacto. No se aplica si el atacante tiene Alcance Largo.

name: bad-dreams
effect: Opposing Pokémon take 1/8 of their maximum HP in damage after each turn while they are asleep.
effectEs: El rival dormido pierde 1/8 de sus PS máximos al final de cada turno.

name: ball-fetch
effect: At any time after the first Poké Ball is thrown and fails to catch a Pokémon, at the end of a turn, if a Pokémon with Ball Fetch is on the field and not holding another item, it will pick up the same type of ball as the first one thrown.
effectEs: Si no lleva objeto, recoge la primera Poké Ball lanzada que falle al final del turno.

name: battery
effect: Ally Pokémon's moves have their power increased to 1.3×.
effectEs: Aumenta la potencia de los movimientos de los aliados a 1,3×.

name: battle-armor
effect:
Moves cannot score critical hits against this Pokémon.

This ability functions identically to Shell Armor.
effectEs: Evita que reciba golpes críticos. Funciona igual que Caparazón.

name: battle-bond
effect:
Transforms this Pokémon into Ash-Greninja after fainting an opponent.  Water Shuriken's power is 20 and always hits three times.

This ability cannot be copied or replaced.  This ability only takes effect for Greninja.
effectEs: Greninja se transforma en Greninja Ash al debilitar a un rival. Shuriken de Agua pasa a 20 de potencia y golpea 3 veces.

name: beads-of-ruin
effect: The power of the Pokémon’s ruinous beads lowers the Sp. Def stats of all Pokémon except itself.
effectEs: El poder de sus abalorios reduce la Defensa Especial de todos los demás Pokémon.

name: beast-boost
effect: Raises this Pokémon's highest stat by one stage when it faints another Pokémon.
effectEs: Al debilitar a un Pokémon, sube un nivel su estadística más alta.

name: berserk
effect: Whenever this Pokémon takes damage from a move that causes its HP to drop below 50%, its Special Attack rises by one stage.
effectEs: Si su PS baja por debajo del 50% por daño, sube un nivel su At. Esp.

name: big-pecks
effect:
This Pokémon's Defense cannot be lowered by other Pokémon.

This Pokémon can still be passed negative Defense modifiers through Heart Swap or Guard Swap.
effectEs: Evita que le bajen la Defensa.

name: blaze
effect: When this Pokémon has 1/3 or less of its HP remaining, its Fire-type moves inflict 1.5× as much regular damage.
effectEs: Potencia los movimientos de tipo Fuego 1,5× cuando sus PS están a 1/3 o menos.

name: bulletproof
effect: Protects against bullet, ball, and bomb-based moves.
effectEs: Inmune a movimientos de bola y bomba como Bola Sombra, Bomba Lodo o Esfera Aural.

name: cheek-pouch
effect: Restores HP upon eating a Berry, in addition to the Berry's effect.
effectEs: Al comer una baya recupera PS y además 1/3 de sus PS máximos.

name: chilling-neigh
effect: When the Pokémon knocks out a target, it utters a chilling neigh, which boosts its Attack stat.
effectEs: Al debilitar a un objetivo, suelta un relincho gélido y sube un nivel su Ataque.

name: chlorophyll
effect:
This Pokémon's Speed is doubled during strong sunlight.

This bonus does not count as a stat modifier.
effectEs: Duplica su Velocidad con sol.

name: clear-body
effect:
This Pokémon cannot have its stats lowered by other Pokémon.

This ability does not prevent any stat losses other than stat modifiers, such as the Speed cut from paralysis.  This Pokémon can still be passed negative stat modifiers through Guard Swap, Heart Swap, or Power Swap.

This ability functions identically to White Smoke in battle.
effectEs: Evita que otros Pokémon le bajen estadísticas.

name: cloud-nine
effect:
While this Pokémon is in battle, weather can still be in play, but will not have any of its effects.

This ability functions identically to Air Lock.
effectEs: Elimina los efectos del clima mientras está en combate, igual que Bucle Aire.

name: color-change
effect:
Whenever this Pokémon takes damage from a move, the Pokémon's type changes to match the move.

If the Pokémon has two types, both are overridden.  The Pokémon must directly take damage; for example, moves blocked by a Substitute will not trigger this ability, nor will moves that deal damage indirectly, such as Spikes.

This ability takes effect on only the last hit of a multiple-hit attack.

In Pokémon Colosseum and XD: Gale of Darkness, this ability does not take effect on Shadow-type moves.
effectEs: Cambia su tipo al del último movimiento que le golpea.

name: comatose
effect: This Pokémon always acts as though it were Asleep.  It cannot be given another status ailment; it's unaffected by Yawn; it can use Sleep Talk; and so on.
effectEs: Siempre está dormido pero puede atacar y no puede tener otros estados. Similar a Letargo Permanente.

name: commander
effect: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it goes inside the mouth of an ally Dondozo if one is on the field. The Pokémon then issues commands from there.
effectEs: Cuando entra con Dondozo, se mete en su boca y sube todas las estadísticas de Dondozo 2 niveles.

name: competitive
effect: Raises Special Attack by two stages upon having any stat lowered.
effectEs: Si le bajan una estadística, sube 2 niveles su At. Esp.

name: compound-eyes
effect:
This Pokémon's moves have 1.3× their accuracy.

This ability has no effect on the one-hit KO moves (Fissure, Guillotine, Horn Drill, and Sheer Cold).

Overworld: If the first Pokémon in the party has this ability, the chance of a wild Pokémon holding a particular item is raised from 50%, 5%, or 1% to 60%, 20%, or 5%, respectively.
effectEs: Aumenta la precisión de sus movimientos 1,3×.

name: contrary
effect: Whenever this Pokémon's stats would be raised, they are instead lowered by the same amount, and vice versa.
effectEs: Invierte los cambios de estadísticas: subidas se vuelven bajadas y viceversa.

name: corrosion
effect: This Pokémon's moves and item ignore the usual immunity of Poison and Steel Pokémon when attempting to inflict poison.
effectEs: Puede envenenar a Pokémon de tipo Acero y Veneno.

name: costar
effect: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it copies an ally’s stat changes.
effectEs: Copia todos los cambios de estadísticas del aliado al entrar.

name: cotton-down
effect: When the Pokémon is hit by an attack, it scatters cotton fluff around and lowers the Speed stats of all Pokémon except itself.
effectEs: Al ser golpeado baja un nivel la Velocidad de todos los Pokémon excepto él.

name: cud-chew
effect: When the Pokémon eats a Berry, it will regurgitate that Berry at the end of the next turn and eat it one more time.
effectEs: Si come una baya, al final del siguiente turno la vuelve a comer.

name: curious-medicine
effect: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it scatters medicine from its shell, which removes all stat changes from allies.
effectEs: Al entrar, elimina los cambios de estadísticas de los aliados.

name: cursed-body
effect: Moves that hit this Pokémon have a 30% chance of being Disabled afterward.
effectEs: Si es golpeado por contacto, 30% de anular el movimiento del rival por 4 turnos.

name: cute-charm
effect:
Whenever a move makes contact with this Pokémon, the move's user has a 30% chance of being infatuated.

Overworld: If the first Pokémon in the party has this ability, any wild Pokémon whose species can be either gender has a 2/3 chance of being set to the opposite gender, and a 1/3 chance of having a random gender as usual.
effectEs: Si es golpeado por contacto, 30% de enamorar al atacante.

name: damp
effect: While this Pokémon is in battle, Self-Destruct and Explosion will fail and Aftermath will not take effect.
effectEs: Evita que se usen movimientos explosivos como Autodestrucción o Explosión.

name: dancer
effect: Whenever another Pokémon uses a dance move, this Pokémon will use the same move immediately afterwards.
effectEs: Copia los movimientos de danza que use otro Pokémon.

name: dark-aura
effect: Strengthens Dark moves for all friendly and opposing Pokémon.
effectEs: Potencia los movimientos de tipo Siniestro de todos a 1,33× mientras está en combate.

name: dauntless-shield
effect: Boosts the Pokémon’s Defense stat the first time the Pokémon enters a battle.
effectEs: Al entrar sube un nivel su Defensa.

name: dazzling
effect: When an opposing Pokémon attempts to use a move that targets this Pokémon or an ally, and that move has priority, it will fail.
effectEs: Evita que el rival use movimientos con prioridad contra él o sus aliados.

name: defeatist
effect: This Pokémon's Attack and Special Attack are halved when it has half its HP or less.
effectEs: Si sus PS están por debajo del 50%, su Ataque y At. Esp. se reducen a la mitad.

name: defiant
effect:
When any of this Pokémon's stats are lowered, its Attack rises by two stages.

If multiple stats are lowered at once, this ability takes effect with each stat lowered.
effectEs: Si le bajan una estadística, sube 2 niveles su Ataque.

name: delta-stream
effect:
When this Pokémon enters battle or gains this ability, the weather becomes a mysterious air current.  A mysterious air current causes moves to not be super effective against Flying; they do neutral damage instead.  Anticipation and Stealth Rock are not affected.

The mysterious air current ends when this Pokémon leaves battle or loses this ability, or when this ability is nullified.  The weather cannot otherwise be changed except by the effects of Desolate Land and Primordial Sea.

Air Lock and Cloud Nine will prevent the effect of a mysterious air current, but will not allow the weather to be changed.
effectEs: Invoca turbulencias que eliminan debilidades del tipo Volador. Solo Rayquaza.

name: desolate-land
effect:
When this Pokémon enters battle or gains this ability, the weather becomes extremely harsh sunlight.  Extremely harsh sunlight has all the properties of Sunny Day and also causes damaging Water moves to fail.

Extremely harsh sunlight ends when this Pokémon leaves battle or loses this ability, or when this ability is nullified.  The weather cannot otherwise be changed except by the effects of Delta Stream and Primordial Sea.

Air Lock and Cloud Nine will prevent the effects of extremely harsh sunlight, including allowing Water moves to work, but will not allow the weather to be changed.
effectEs: Invoca sol abrasador que impide movimientos de Agua y anula desvanecimiento. Solo Groudon Primigenio.

name: disguise
effect:
If this Pokémon is in its Disguised Form and takes damage from a move, it switches to its Busted Form and the damage is prevented.  Other effects are not prevented.

This ability cannot be copied or replaced.  This ability only takes effect for Mimikyu.
effectEs: Su disfraz le permite bloquear el primer golpe que recibe sin daño. Solo Mimikyu.

name: download
effect:
When this Pokémon enters battle, its Attack or Special Attack, whichever corresponds to its opponents' weaker total defensive stat, rises one stage.  In the event of a tie, Special Attack is raised.

This ability also takes effect when acquired during a battle.
effectEs: Sube Ataque si la Defensa rival es menor, o At. Esp. si es al revés.

name: dragonize
effect: The Pokémon's Normal-type moves become Dragon-type moves and their power is boosted by 20%.
effectEs: Convierte movimientos de tipo Normal en tipo Dragón y potencia 1,2×.

name: dragons-maw
effect: Increases the power of Dragon-type moves used by this Pokémon by 50%.
effectEs: Potencia movimientos de tipo Dragón 1,5×.

name: drizzle
effect:
The weather changes to rain when this Pokémon enters battle and does not end unless replaced by another weather condition.

If multiple Pokémon with this ability, Drought, Sand Stream, or Snow Warning are sent out at the same time, the abilities will activate in order of Speed, respecting Trick Room.  Each ability's weather will cancel the previous weather, and only the weather summoned by the slowest of the Pokémon will stay.
effectEs: Invoca lluvia al entrar.

name: drought
effect:
The weather changes to strong sunlight when this Pokémon enters battle and does not end unless cancelled by another weather condition.

If multiple Pokémon with this ability, Drizzle, Sand Stream, or Snow Warning are sent out at the same time, the abilities will activate in order of Speed, respecting Trick Room.  Each ability's weather will cancel the previous weather, and only the weather summoned by the slowest of the Pokémon will stay.
effectEs: Invoca sol al entrar.

name: dry-skin
effect: This Pokémon takes 1/8 of its maximum HP in damage after each turn during strong sunlight, but it heals for 1/8 of its HP each turn during rain.  This Pokémon takes 1.25× as much damage from Fire-type moves, but whenever a Water move hits it, it heals for 1/4 its maximum HP instead.
effectEs: Recupera PS con lluvia o movimientos de Agua, pero pierde PS con sol o movimientos de Fuego. Débil a Fuego 1,25×.

name: early-bird
effect:
This Pokémon's remaining sleep turn count falls by 2 rather than 1.

If this Pokémon's sleep counter is at 1, it will fall to 0 and then the Pokémon will wake up.
effectEs: Se despierta en la mitad de turnos de sueño.

name: earth-eater
effect: If hit by a Ground-type move, the Pokémon has its HP restored instead of taking damage.
effectEs: Inmune a movimientos de tipo Tierra y recupera 1/4 de PS máximos al ser golpeado por uno.

name: eelevate
effect: The Pokémon floats off the ground, making it immune to Ground-type moves, as well as the Spikes, Toxic Spikes, and Sticky Web statuses. When the Pokémon knocks out a target with an attack, its highest stat is boosted by 1 stage.
effectEs: Convierte movimientos Normal en Eléctrico y potencia 1,2×.

name: effect-spore
effect:
Whenever a move makes contact with this Pokémon, the move's user has a 30% chance of being paralyzed, poisoned, or put to sleep, chosen at random.

Nothing is done to compensate if the move's user is immune to one of these ailments; there is simply a lower chance that the move's user will be affected.
effectEs: 30% de causar parálisis, envenenamiento o sueño al ser golpeado por contacto.

name: electric-surge
effect: When this Pokémon enters battle, it changes the terrain to Electric Terrain.
effectEs: Invoca Campo Eléctrico al entrar.

name: electromorphosis
effect: The Pokémon becomes charged when it takes damage, boosting the power of the next Electric-type move the Pokémon uses.
effectEs: Si es golpeado por un movimiento, se carga y su siguiente movimiento Eléctrico tiene 2× potencia.

name: embody-aspect
effect: Embody Aspect boosts a particular stat, depending on the form of a Terastallized Ogerpon
effectEs: Al entrar, según la máscara de Ogerpon, sube una estadística diferente.

name: emergency-exit
effect: After this Pokémon is hit by a move, if that move caused this Pokémon's HP to drop below half, it switches out.
effectEs: Si sus PS bajan por debajo del 50%, huye o cambia de Pokémon.

name: fairy-aura
effect: Strengthens Fairy moves for all friendly and opposing Pokémon.
effectEs: Potencia movimientos de tipo Hada de todos a 1,33× mientras está en combate.

name: filter
effect:
This Pokémon takes 0.75× as much damage from moves that are super effective against it.

This ability functions identically to Solid Rock.
effectEs: Reduce el daño supereficaz recibido a 3/4.

name: fire-mane
effect: Boosts the power of the Pokémon's Fire-type moves by 50%.
effectEs: Fuego + inmunidad a quemadura. Al golpear con contacto puede quemar.

name: flame-body
effect:
Whenever a move makes contact with this Pokémon, the move's user has a 30% chance of being burned.

Overworld: If any Pokémon in the party has this ability, each egg in the party has its hatch counter decreased by 2 (rather than 1) each step cycle, making eggs hatch roughly twice as quickly.  This effect does not stack if multiple Pokémon have this ability or Magma Armor.
effectEs: 30% de quemar al atacante si le golpea por contacto.

name: flare-boost
effect: This Pokémon has 1.5× its Special Attack when burned.
effectEs: Si está quemado, su At. Esp. sube 1,5×.

name: flash-fire
effect:
This Pokémon is immune to Fire-type moves.  Once this Pokémon has been hit by a Fire move, its own Fire moves will inflict 1.5× as much damage until it leaves battle.

This ability has no effect while the Pokémon is frozen.  The Fire damage bonus is retained even if the Pokémon is frozen and thawed or the ability is lost or disabled.  Fire moves will ignore this Pokémon's Substitute.  This ability takes effect even on non-damaging moves, i.e. Will-O-Wisp.
effectEs: Inmune a movimientos de Fuego. Si es golpeado por uno, sus movimientos de Fuego hacen 1,5×.

name: flower-gift
effect:
Friendly Pokémon have 1.5× their Attack and Special Defense during strong sunlight if any friendly Pokémon has this ability.

Unlike Forecast, Multitype, and Zen Mode, this ability is not tied to its Pokémon's form change; Cherrim will switch between its forms even if it loses this ability.  As such, this ability also works if obtained by a Pokémon other than Cherrim.
effectEs: Con sol, sube Ataque y Def. Esp. de Cherrim y aliados 1,5×.

name: flower-veil
effect: Protects friendly Grass Pokémon from having their stats lowered by other Pokémon.
effectEs: Protege a aliados de tipo Planta de bajadas de stats y estados.

name: fluffy
effect: Damage from contact moves is halved.  Damage from Fire moves is doubled.
effectEs: Recibe la mitad de daño de contacto, pero el doble de movimientos de Fuego.

name: forecast
effect:
During rain, strong sunlight, or hail, this Pokémon's type changes to Water, Fire, or Ice, respectively, and its form changes to match.

This ability has no effect for any Pokémon other than Castform.

If the weather ends or becomes anything that does not trigger this ability, or a Pokémon with Air Lock or Cloud Nine enters battle, this Pokémon's type and form revert to their default.  If this ability is lost or disabled, this Pokémon cannot change its current type and form until it regains its ability.
effectEs: Castform cambia de tipo según el clima.

name: forewarn
effect:
When this Pokémon enters battle, it reveals the move with the highest base power known by any opposing Pokémon to all participating trainers.

In the event of a tie, one is chosen at random.

Moves without a listed base power are assigned one as follows:

Power | Moves
----: | -----
  160 | One-hit KO moves: Fissure, Guillotine, Horn Drill, and Sheer Cold
  120 | Counter moves: Counter, Metal Burst, and Mirror Coat
   80 | Variable power or set damage: Crush Grip, Dragon Rage, Electro Ball, Endeavor, Final Gambit, Flail, Frustration, Grass Knot, Gyro Ball, Heat Crash, Heavy Slam, Hidden Power, Low Kick, Natural Gift, Night Shade, Psywave, Return, Reversal, Seismic Toss, Sonic Boom, Trump Card, and Wring Out
    0 | Any such move not listed
effectEs: Al entrar revela el movimiento más potente del rival.

name: friend-guard
effect:
All friendly Pokémon take 0.75× as much direct damage from moves while this Pokémon is in battle.

This effect stacks if multiple allied Pokémon have it.
effectEs: Reduce el daño que reciben los aliados a 3/4.

name: frisk
effect:
When this Pokémon enters battle, it reveals an opposing Pokémon's held item to all participating trainers.

In a double battle, if one opponent has an item, this Pokémon will Frisk that Pokémon; if both have an item, it will Frisk one at random.
effectEs: Al entrar revela el objeto del rival.

name: full-metal-body
effect:
This Pokémon's stats cannot be lowered by other Pokémon's moves or abilities.  This effect only applies to normal stat modifications and not more exotic effects such as Topsy-Turvy or Power Swap.

This Ability is not bypassed by Mold Breaker, Teravolt, or Turboblaze.
effectEs: Evita que le bajen estadísticas, igual que Cuerpo Puro.

name: fur-coat
effect: Halves damage from physical attacks.
effectEs: Reduce a la mitad el daño de movimientos físicos.

name: gale-wings
effect: Raises Flying moves' priority by one stage.
effectEs: Si tiene PS al máximo, sus movimientos de tipo Volador tienen +1 prioridad.

name: galvanize
effect: When this Pokémon uses a Normal moves, that move is Electric its power is 1.2×.
effectEs: Convierte movimientos Normal en Eléctrico y potencia 1,2×.

name: gluttony
effect: This Pokémon eats any held Berry triggered by low HP when it falls below 50% of its HP, regardless of the Berry's usual threshold.
effectEs: Come bayas cuando sus PS bajan al 50% en vez de 25%.

name: good-as-gold
effect: A body of pure, solid gold gives the Pokémon full immunity to other Pokémon’s status moves.
effectEs: Inmune a movimientos de estado. Solo Gholdengo.

name: gooey
effect: Lowers attacking Pokémon's Speed by one stage on contact.
effectEs: Si le golpean por contacto, baja un nivel la Velocidad del atacante.

name: gorilla-tactics
effect: Boosts the Pokémon’s Attack stat but only allows the use of the first selected move.
effectEs: Sube 1,5× el Ataque pero solo puede usar el primer movimiento elegido. Similar a Cinta Elegida.

name: grass-pelt
effect: Boosts Defense while Grassy Terrain is in effect.
effectEs: Duplica su Defensa en Campo de Hierba.

name: grassy-surge
effect: When this Pokémon enters battle, it changes the terrain to Grassy Terrain.
effectEs: Invoca Campo de Hierba al entrar.

name: grim-neigh
effect: When the Pokémon knocks out a target, it utters a terrifying neigh, which boosts its Sp. Atk stat.
effectEs: Al debilitar a un objetivo, suelta un relincho espectral y sube un nivel su At. Esp.

name: guard-dog
effect: Boosts the Pokémon’s Attack stat if intimidated. Moves and items that would force the Pokémon to switch out also fail to work.
effectEs: Inmune a intimidación y si le intentan intimidar sube Ataque. Impide cambio forzado.

name: gulp-missile
effect: When the Pokémon uses Surf or Dive, it will come back with prey. When it takes damage, it will spit out the prey to attack.
effectEs: Cuando usa Surf o Buceo, si tiene más de 50% PS escupe Cramorant Tragón (+Def), si no, Atragantado (-Def) y baja Def rival.

name: guts
effect:
Whenever this Pokémon is asleep, burned, paralyzed, or poisoned, it has 1.5× its Attack.  This Pokémon is not affected by the usual Attack cut from a burn.

This bonus does not count as a stat modifier.
effectEs: Si tiene un problema de estado, su Ataque sube 1,5×. No pierde Ataque por quemadura.

name: hadron-engine
effect: Turns the ground into Electric Terrain when the Pokémon enters a battle. The futuristic engine within the Pokémon also boosts its Sp. Atk stat on Electric Terrain.
effectEs: Al entrar invoca Campo Eléctrico y sube su At. Esp. si está en el campo.

name: harvest
effect: After each turn, if the last item this Pokémon consumed was a Berry and it is not currently holding an item, it has a 50% chance of regaining that Berry, or a 100% chance during strong sunlight.
effectEs: 50% de recuperar baya usada al final del turno, 100% con sol.

name: healer
effect: Friendly Pokémon next to this Pokémon in double and triple battles each have a 30% chance of being cured of any major status ailment after each turn.
effectEs: 30% de curar problema de estado de un aliado al final del turno.

name: heatproof
effect: This Pokémon takes half as much damage from Fire-type moves and burns.
effectEs: Reduce a la mitad el daño de tipo Fuego y quemaduras.

name: heavy-metal
effect: This Pokémon has double the usual weight for its species.
effectEs: Duplica su peso.

name: honey-gather
effect:
This Pokémon has a chance of picking up Honey after each battle.  This chance starts at 5% and rises another 5% after every tenth level: 5% from level 1–10, 10% from 11–20, and so on, up to 50% from 91–100.

This ability is checked after the battle ends, at which point any temporary ability changes have worn off.
effectEs: Puede recoger miel tras el combate.

name: hospitality
effect: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it showers its ally with hospitality, restoring a small amount of the ally's HP.
effectEs: Al entrar recupera 1/4 de PS máximos del aliado.

name: huge-power
effect:
This Pokémon's Attack is doubled while in battle.

This bonus does not count as a stat modifier.

This ability functions identically to Pure Power.
effectEs: Duplica su Ataque.

name: hunger-switch
effect: The Pokémon changes its form, alternating between its Full Belly Mode and Hangry Mode after the end of every turn.
effectEs: Morpeko cambia de forma cada turno alternando tipo Eléctrico/Siniestro.

name: hustle
effect:
This Pokémon's physical moves do 1.5× as much regular damage, but have 0.8× their usual accuracy.

Special moves are unaffected.  Moves that do set damage, such as Seismic Toss, have their accuracy affected, but not their damage.

Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, higher-levelled Pokémon have their encounter rate increased.
effectEs: Sube Ataque 1,5× pero baja precisión de movimientos físicos a 80%.

name: hydration
effect: This Pokémon is cured of any major status ailment after each turn during rain.
effectEs: Cura problemas de estado al final del turno si llueve.

name: hyper-cutter
effect:
This Pokémon's Attack cannot be lowered by other Pokémon.

This ability does not prevent any Attack losses other than stat modifiers, such as the Attack cut from a burn.  This Pokémon can still be passed negative Attack modifiers through Heart Swap or Power Swap.
effectEs: Evita que le bajen el Ataque.

name: ice-body
effect: This Pokémon heals for 1/16 of its maximum HP after each turn during hail, and it does not take hail damage regardless of type.
effectEs: Recupera 1/16 de PS por turno con granizo/nieve.

name: ice-face
effect: When an Eiscue that's in its Ice Face form is hit by a physical move, it takes no damage and changes into its Noice Face form. If a hailstorm or snowstorm begins while Eiscue is in its Noice Face form, or if it is sent out in its Noice Face form during hail, it will immediately revert to its Ice Face form.
effectEs: Eiscue en Forma Deshielo bloquea el primer golpe físico. Se restaura con granizo.

name: ice-scales
effect: The Pokémon is protected by ice scales, which halve the damage taken from special moves.
effectEs: Reduce a la mitad el daño de movimientos especiales.

name: illuminate
effect:
Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, the wild encounter rate is doubled.

This ability has no effect in battle.
effectEs: Duplica la tasa de encuentro si lidera.

name: illusion
effect:
This Pokémon, upon being sent out, appears to have the species, nickname, and Poké Ball of the last Pokémon in the party that is able to battle.  This illusion breaks upon being hit by a damaging move.

Other damage, e.g. from weather or Spikes, does not break the illusion, nor does damage done to a Substitute.

If the party order becomes temporarily shuffled around as Pokémon are switched out in battle, this ability chooses the last Pokémon according to that shuffled order.
effectEs: Se disfraza del último Pokémon del equipo hasta recibir daño.

name: immunity
effect:
This Pokémon cannot be poisoned.  This includes bad poison.

If a Pokémon is poisoned and acquires this ability, its poison is healed; this includes when regaining a lost ability upon leaving battle.
effectEs: Inmune a envenenamiento.

name: imposter
effect: This Pokémon transforms into a random opponent upon entering battle.  This effect is identical to the move Transform.
effectEs: Se transforma en el rival al entrar. Solo Ditto.

name: infiltrator
effect: This Pokémon's moves ignore Light Screen, Reflect, and Safeguard.
effectEs: Ignora Sustituto, Reflejo, Pantalla de Luz, Velo Aurora y Neblina.

name: innards-out
effect: When this Pokémon faints from an opponent's move, that opponent takes damage equal to the HP this Pokémon had remaining.
effectEs: Si es debilitado, el atacante pierde PS igual a los que perdió este Pokémon en el último golpe.

name: inner-focus
effect: This Pokémon cannot flinch.
effectEs: Evita retroceder por miedo. Inmune a intimidación en algunas generaciones.

name: insomnia
effect:
This Pokémon cannot be asleep.

This causes Rest to fail altogether.  If a Pokémon is asleep and acquires this ability, it will immediately wake up; this includes when regaining a lost ability upon leaving battle.

This ability functions identically to Vital Spirit in battle.
effectEs: Inmune a sueño.

name: intimidate
effect:
When this Pokémon enters battle, the opponent's Attack is lowered by one stage.  In a double battle, both opponents are affected.

This ability also takes effect when acquired during a battle, but will not take effect again if lost and reobtained without leaving battle.

This ability has no effect on an opponent that has a Substitute.

Overworld: If the first Pokémon in the party has this ability, any random encounter with a Pokémon five or more levels lower than it has a 50% chance of being skipped.
effectEs: Al entrar baja un nivel el Ataque del rival.

name: intrepid-sword
effect: Boosts the Pokémon’s Attack stat the first time the Pokémon enters a battle.
effectEs: Al entrar sube un nivel su Ataque. Solo Zacian.

name: iron-barbs
effect:
Whenever a move makes contact with this Pokémon, the move's user takes 1/8 of its maximum HP in damage.

This ability functions identically to Rough Skin.
effectEs: Si le golpean por contacto, el atacante pierde 1/8 de PS máximos.

name: iron-fist
effect:
Moves flagged as being punch-based have 1.2× their base power for this Pokémon.

Sucker Punch is not flagged as punch-based; its original, Japanese name only means "surprise attack".
effectEs: Potencia movimientos de puño 1,2×.

name: justified
effect:
Whenever a Dark-type move hits this Pokémon, its Attack rises one stage.

The move is not negated in any way.
effectEs: Si recibe un movimiento Siniestro, sube un nivel su Ataque.

name: keen-eye
effect:
This Pokémon cannot have its accuracy lowered.

This ability does not prevent any accuracy losses other than stat modifiers, such as the accuracy cut from fog; nor does it prevent other Pokémon's evasion from making this Pokémon's moves less accurate.  This Pokémon can still be passed negative accuracy modifiers through Heart Swap.

Overworld: If the first Pokémon in the party has this ability, any random encounter with a Pokémon five or more levels lower than it has a 50% chance of being skipped.
effectEs: Evita que le bajen la precisión.

name: klutz
effect:
In battle, this Pokémon cannot use its held item, nor will the item have any passive effect on the battle, positive or negative.  This Pokémon also cannot use Fling.

The Speed cut from the Iron Ball and the effort items (the Macho Brace, Power Weight, Power Bracer, Power Belt, Power Lens, Power Band, and Power Anklet) is unaffected.  Items that do not directly affect the battle, such as the Exp. Share, the Amulet Coin, or the Soothe Bell, work as usual.  All held items work as usual out of battle.

Other moves that use the held item, such as Natural Gift and Switcheroo, work as usual.
effectEs: No puede usar su objeto.

name: leaf-guard
effect:
This Pokémon cannot be given a major status ailment during strong sunlight.

This ability does not heal prior status ailments.  Rest will fail altogether with this ability in effect.  Yawn will immediately fail if used on this Pokémon during strong sunlight, and an already-used Yawn will fail if the weather turns to strong sunlight in the meantime.
effectEs: Con sol evita problemas de estado.

name: levitate
effect:
This Pokémon is immune to Ground-type moves, Spikes, Toxic Spikes, and Arena Trap.

This ability is disabled during Gravity or Ingrain, or while holding an Iron Ball.  This ability is not disabled during Roost.
effectEs: Inmune a movimientos de tipo Tierra.

name: libero
effect: Changes the Pokémon’s type to the type of the move it’s about to use. This works only once each time the Pokémon enters battle.
effectEs: Cambia su tipo al del movimiento que va a usar. Solo Cinderace.

name: light-metal
effect: This Pokémon has half the usual weight for its species.
effectEs: Reduce su peso a la mitad.

name: lightning-rod
effect:
All other Pokémon's single-target Electric-type moves are redirected to this Pokémon if it is an eligible target.  Other Pokémon's Electric moves raise this Pokémon's Special Attack one stage, negating any other effect on it, and cannot miss it.

If the move's intended target also has this ability, the move is not redirected.  When multiple Pokémon with this ability are possible targets for redirection, the move is redirected to the one with the highest Speed stat, or, in the case of a tie, to a random tied Pokémon.  Follow Me takes precedence over this ability.

If the Pokémon is a Ground-type and thus immune to Electric moves, its immunity prevents the Special Attack boost.
effectEs: Atrae movimientos Eléctricos, inmune a ellos y sube un nivel su At. Esp.

name: limber
effect:
This Pokémon cannot be paralyzed.

If a Pokémon is paralyzed and acquires this ability, its paralysis is healed; this includes when regaining a lost ability upon leaving battle.
effectEs: Inmune a parálisis.

name: lingering-aroma
effect: Contact with the Pokémon changes the attacker’s Ability to Lingering Aroma.
effectEs: Si le golpean por contacto, cambia la habilidad del atacante a esta.

name: liquid-ooze
effect:
Whenever a Pokémon would heal after hitting this Pokémon with a leeching move like Absorb, it instead loses as many HP as it would usually gain.

Dream Eater is unaffected.
effectEs: Si el rival usa drenaje, en vez de curarse pierde PS.

name: liquid-voice
effect: When this Pokémon uses a move that is sound-based, that move's type is Water.
effectEs: Convierte movimientos de sonido en tipo Agua.

name: long-reach
effect: A move used by this Pokémon will not make contact.
effectEs: Usa movimientos de contacto sin hacer contacto.

name: magic-bounce
effect:
When this Pokémon is targeted by a move flagged as being reflectable, the move is redirected to its user.

All reflectable moves are non-damaging, and most non-damaging moves that target other Pokémon are reflectable.

A move reflected by this ability or Magic Coat cannot be reflected back.
effectEs: Rebota movimientos de estado al rival.

name: magic-guard
effect:
This Pokémon is immune to damage not directly caused by a move.

For example, this Pokémon takes no damage from from weather, recoil, status ailments, or Spikes, but it still suffers from the Attack cut when burned, and a Life Orb will still power up this Pokémon's moves without damaging it.  Anything that directly depends on such damage will also not happen; for example, Leech Seed will neither hurt this Pokémon nor heal the opponent, and Pokémon with a Jaboca Berry or Rowap Berry will not consume the berry when hit by this Pokémon.

The following are unaffected: Struggle, Pain Split (whether used by or against this Pokémon), Belly Drum, Substitute, Curse, moves that knock the user out, and damage from confusion.

This Pokémon will neither lose nor regain HP if it drains HP from a Pokémon with Liquid Ooze.

If this Pokémon is badly poisoned, the poison counter is still increased each turn; if the Pokémon loses this ability, it will begin taking as much damage as it would be if it had been taking increasing damage each turn.
effectEs: Solo recibe daño de ataques directos, no de clima, estados, retroceso, etc.

name: magician
effect: Steals the target's held item when the bearer uses a damaging move.
effectEs: Roba el objeto del rival si le golpea sin llevar objeto.

name: magma-armor
effect:
This Pokémon cannot be frozen.

If a Pokémon is frozen and acquires this ability, it will immediately thaw out; this includes when regaining a lost ability upon leaving battle.

Overworld: If any Pokémon in the party has this ability, each egg in the party has its hatch counter decreased by 2 (rather than 1) each step cycle, making eggs hatch roughly twice as quickly.  This effect does not stack if multiple Pokémon have this ability or Flame Body.
effectEs: Inmune a congelamiento.

name: magnet-pull
effect:
While this Pokémon is in battle, opposing Steel-type Pokémon cannot flee or switch out.

Pokémon with Run Away can still flee.  Pokémon can still switch out with the use of a move or item.

Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, Steel-type Pokémon have a higher encounter rate.
effectEs: Impide que Pokémon de tipo Acero huyan o cambien.

name: marvel-scale
effect:
Whenever this Pokémon has a major status ailment, it has 1.5× its Defense.

This bonus does not count as a stat modifier.
effectEs: Si tiene problema de estado, su Defensa sube 1,5×.

name: mega-launcher
effect: Strengthens aura and pulse moves to 1.5× their power.
effectEs: Potencia movimientos de pulso/aura 1,5×.

name: mega-sol
effect: Even when the sunlight has not turned harsh, the Pokémon can use its moves as if the weather were harsh sunlight.
effectEs: Inmune a cambios de stats por el rival.

name: merciless
effect: This Pokémon's moves critical hit against poisoned targets.
effectEs: Siempre hace crítico contra rivales envenenados.

name: mimicry
effect: Changes the Pokémon’s type depending on the terrain.
effectEs: Cambia su tipo según el campo activo.

name: minds-eye
effect: Mind's Eye enables the Pokémon with this Ability to hit Ghost-type Pokémon with damage-dealing Normal- and Fighting-type moves. It also prevents other Pokémon from lowering the Pokémon's accuracy and ignores changes to the opponents' evasion.
effectEs: Puede golpear a tipo Fantasma con Normal/Lucha, ignora evasión y es inmune a intimidación.

name: minus
effect:
This Pokémon has 1.5× its Special Attack if any friendly Pokémon has Plus or Minus.

This bonus does not count as a stat modifier.  If either ability is disabled by Gastro Acid, both lose their effect.
effectEs: Sube At. Esp. 1,5× si un aliado tiene Más.

name: mirror-armor
effect: Bounces back only the stat-lowering effects that the Pokémon receives.
effectEs: Rebota bajadas de estadísticas al rival.

name: misty-surge
effect: When this Pokémon enters battle, it changes the terrain to Misty Terrain.
effectEs: Invoca Campo de Niebla al entrar.

name: mold-breaker
effect:
This Pokémon's moves completely ignore abilities that could hinder or prevent their effect on the target.

For example, this Pokémon's moves ignore abilities that would fully negate them, such as Water Absorb; abilities that would prevent any of their effects, such as Clear Body, Shell Armor, or Sticky Hold; and abilities that grant any general protective benefit, such as Simple, Snow Cloak, or Thick Fat.  If an ability could either hinder or help this Pokémon's moves, e.g. Dry Skin or Unaware, the ability is ignored either way.

Abilities that do not fit this description, even if they could hinder moves in some other way, are not affected.  For example, Cursed Body only affects potential future uses of the move, while Liquid Ooze and Shadow Tag can only hinder a move's effect on the user.  This ablity cannot ignore type or form changes granted by abilities, for example Color Change or Forecast; nor effects that were caused by abilities but are no longer tied to an ability, such as the rain from Drizzle.  This ability cannot ignore Multitype at all.

An ability ignored by this ability is only nullified while the move is being used.  For example, this Pokémon's moves can paralyze a Pokémon with Limber, but Limber will activate and heal the paralysis immediately thereafter, and this Pokémon's Spikes are not affected by this ability after they have been placed.

When this Pokémon enters battle, all participating trainers are notified that it has this ability.

This ability functions identically to Teravolt and Turboblaze.
effectEs: Ignora habilidades que bloquean sus movimientos.

name: moody
effect:
After each turn, one of this Pokémon's stats at random rises two stages, and another falls one stage.

If a stat is already at 6 or -6 stages, it will not be chosen to be increased or decreased, respectively.
effectEs: Al final de cada turno sube 2 niveles una estadística al azar y baja 1 otra.

name: motor-drive
effect:
Whenever an Electric-type move hits this Pokémon, its Speed rises one stage, negating any other effect on it.

This ability will not take effect if this Pokémon is immune to Electric moves.  Electric moves will ignore this Pokémon's Substitute.

This effect includes non-damaging moves, i.e. Thunder Wave.
effectEs: Inmune a Eléctrico y sube Velocidad un nivel si es golpeado por uno.

name: moxie
effect:
This Pokémon's Attack rises one stage upon knocking out another Pokémon, even a friendly Pokémon.

This ability does not take effect when the Pokémon indirectly causes another Pokémon to faint, e.g. through poison or Spikes.

If this Pokémon knocks out a Pokémon with Mummy, the former's ability will change without taking effect.
effectEs: Al debilitar a un rival sube un nivel su Ataque.

name: multiscale
effect: This Pokémon takes half as much damage when it is hit having full HP.
effectEs: Si tiene PS al máximo, recibe la mitad de daño.

name: multitype
effect:
If this Pokémon is holding an elemental Plate, its type and form change to match the Plate.

This Pokémon's held item, whether or not it is a Plate, cannot be taken by Covet or Thief, nor removed by Knock Off, nor traded by Switcheroo or Trick.  Covet, Thief, and Knock Off still inflict damage against this Pokémon.  Unlike with Sticky Hold, this Pokémon cannot use Fling, Switcheroo, or Trick to lose its item itself, nor gain an item through Switcheroo or Trick if it does not have one.

This ability has no effect for any Pokémon other than Arceus.  This ability cannot be traded with Skill Swap, nor copied with Role Play or Trace, nor disabled with Gastro Acid, nor changed with Worry Seed.  This Pokémon cannot use Skill Swap or Role Play to lose its ability itself.  Mold Breaker cannot ignore this ability.

If a Pokémon Transforms into an Arceus with this ability, it will Transform into Arceus's default, Normal-type form.  If the Transforming Pokémon is holding a Plate, this ability will then activate and change the Pokémon into the corresponding form.
effectEs: Cambia su tipo según la tabla que lleve. Solo Arceus.

name: mummy
effect:
Whenever a contact move hits this Pokémon, the attacking Pokémon's ability changes to Mummy.

Multitype is unaffected.  If a Pokémon with Moxie knocks this Pokémon out, the former's ability will change without taking effect.
effectEs: Si le golpean por contacto, cambia la habilidad del atacante a Momia.

name: mycelium-might
effect: The Pokémon will always act more slowly when using status moves, but these moves will be unimpeded by the Ability of the target.
effectEs: Sus movimientos de estado siempre van al último pero ignoran habilidades del rival.

name: natural-cure
effect:
This Pokémon is cured of any major status ailment when it is switched out for another Pokémon.

If this ability is acquired during battle, the Pokémon is cured upon leaving battle before losing the temporary ability.
effectEs: Cura sus problemas de estado al salir del combate.

name: neuroforce
effect: Increases super-effective damage dealt to 1.25×.
effectEs: Potencia movimientos supereficaces 1,25×.

name: neutralizing-gas
effect: While the Pokémon is in the battle, the effects of all other Pokémon’s Abilities will be nullified or will not be triggered.
effectEs: Anula todas las demás habilidades mientras está en combate.

name: no-guard
effect:
Moves used by or against this Pokémon never miss.

One-hit KO moves are unaffected.  Moves affected by this ability can hit Pokémon during the preparation turn of moves like Dig or Fly.

Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, the wild encounter rate is doubled.
effectEs: Todos los movimientos, suyos y del rival, nunca fallan.

name: normalize
effect:
This Pokémon's moves all act as if they were Normal-type.

Moves that inflict typeless damage do so as usual.  Moves of variable type, such as Hidden Power, are affected.  They otherwise work as usual, however; Weather Ball, for example, is always forced to be Normal, but it still has doubled power and looks different during weather.

As Thunder Wave is prevented by immunities, unlike most non-damaging moves, it does not affect Ghost-type Pokémon under the effect of this ability.
effectEs: Todos sus movimientos se vuelven de tipo Normal y potencia 1,2×.

name: oblivious
effect:
This Pokémon cannot be infatuated and is immune to Captivate.

If a Pokémon is infatuated and acquires this ability, its infatuation is cleared.
effectEs: Inmune a Atracción, Cautivar, Mofa y similares.

name: opportunist
effect: If an opponent’s stat is boosted, the Pokémon seizes the opportunity to boost the same stat for itself.
effectEs: Copia las subidas de estadísticas del rival cuando este las sube.

name: orichalcum-pulse
effect: Turns the sunlight harsh when the Pokémon enters a battle. The ancient pulse thrumming through the Pokémon also boosts its Attack stat in harsh sunlight.
effectEs: Con sol, sube su Ataque. Solo Koraidon. Invoca sol al entrar.

name: overcoat
effect: This Pokémon does not take damage from weather.
effectEs: Inmune a polvos, esporas, Granizo y Tormenta Arena.

name: overgrow
effect: When this Pokémon has 1/3 or less of its HP remaining, its Grass-type moves inflict 1.5× as much regular damage.
effectEs: Potencia movimientos Planta 1,5× con PS a 1/3 o menos.

name: own-tempo
effect:
This Pokémon cannot be confused.

If a Pokémon is confused and acquires this ability, its confusion will immediately be healed.
effectEs: Inmune a confusión e intimidación.

name: parental-bond
effect: Lets the bearer hit twice with damaging moves.  The second hit has half power.
effectEs: Ataca dos veces, la segunda con 1/4 de potencia. Solo Kangaskhan Mega.

name: pastel-veil
effect: Prevents the Pokémon and its teammates from being poisoned. It also cures teammates of poisoning when it enters the battlefield.
effectEs: Protege a él y aliados de envenenamiento y cura veneno al entrar.

name: perish-body
effect: When the Pokémon with Perish Body is hit with a contact move, both the attacker and the Pokémon with Perish Body will faint in three turns.
effectEs: Si es golpeado por contacto, ambos Pokémon entran en cuenta atrás de 3 turnos para debilitarse.

name: pickpocket
effect:
Whenever a move makes contact with this Pokémon, if it does not have a held item, it steals the attacker's held item.

This Pokémon cannot steal upon being knocked out.  It can steal if the attacker has a Substitute, but cannot steal when its own Substitute is hit.  If a move hits multiple times, only the last hit triggers this ability.  If this Pokémon is wild, it cannot steal from a trained Pokémon.
effectEs: Roba el objeto del atacante si le golpea por contacto.

name: pickup
effect:
At the end of each turn, if another Pokémon consumed or Flung a held item that turn, this Pokémon picks up the item if it is not already holding one.  After each battle, this Pokémon has a 10% chance of picking up an item if it is not already holding one.

The Air Balloon and Eject Button cannot be picked up.

The items that may be found vary by game, and, since Pokémon Emerald, by the Pokémon's level.  This ability is checked after the battle ends, at which point any temporary ability changes have worn off.
effectEs: Recoge objetos usados por otros o puede encontrar objetos tras el combate.

name: piercing-drill
effect: When the Pokémon uses contact moves, it can hit even targets that are protecting themselves, dealing 1/4 of the damage that the move would otherwise deal. Everything aside from the target's protective effects is still triggered.
effectEs: Sus movimientos ignoran habilidades del rival.

name: pixilate
effect: Turns the bearer's Normal-type moves into Fairy moves.  Moves changed by this ability have 1.3× their power.
effectEs: Convierte movimientos Normal en Hada y potencia 1,2×.

name: plus
effect:
This Pokémon has 1.5× its Special Attack if any friendly Pokémon has Plus or Minus.

This bonus does not count as a stat modifier.  If either ability is disabled by Gastro Acid, both lose their effect.
effectEs: Sube At. Esp. 1,5× si un aliado tiene Menos.

name: poison-heal
effect: If this Pokémon is poisoned, it will heal for 1/8 of its maximum HP after each turn rather than taking damage.  This includes bad poison.
effectEs: Si está envenenado recupera 1/8 de PS por turno en vez de perderlos.

name: poison-point
effect: Whenever a move makes contact with this Pokémon, the move's user has a 30% chance of being poisoned.
effectEs: 30% de envenenar al rival si le golpea por contacto.

name: poison-puppeteer
effect: When a Pokémon is poisoned by any of Pecharunt's moves, it will also become confused.
effectEs: Envenena y confunde al rival si le golpea con movimiento que envenena.

name: poison-touch
effect:
This Pokémon's contact moves have a 30% chance of poisoning the target with each hit.

This counts as an extra effect for the purposes of Shield Dust.  This ability takes effect before Mummy.
effectEs: 30% de envenenar si ataca por contacto.

name: power-construct
effect:
Transforms 10% or 50% Zygarde into Complete Forme when its HP is below 50%.

This ability cannot be copied or replaced.  This ability only takes effect for Zygarde.
effectEs: Zygarde cambia a Forma Completa al 50% PS.

name: power-of-alchemy
effect: When an ally faints, this Pokémon gains its Ability.
effectEs: Copia la habilidad de un aliado debilitado.

name: power-spot
effect: "The power of moves used by the allies of the Pokémon with Power Spot is increased by 30%."
effectEs: Potencia movimientos de aliados 1,3×.

name: prankster
effect: This Pokémon's non-damaging moves have their priority increased by one stage.
effectEs: Movimientos de estado tienen +1 prioridad.

name: pressure
effect:
Moves targetting this Pokémon use one extra PP.

This ability stacks if multiple targets have it.  This ability still affects moves that fail or miss.  This ability does not affect ally moves that target either the entire field or just its side, nor this Pokémon's self-targetted moves; it does, however, affect single-targetted ally moves aimed at this Pokémon, ally moves that target all other Pokémon, and opponents' moves that target the entire field.  If this ability raises a move's PP cost above its remaining PP, it will use all remaining PP.

When this Pokémon enters battle, all participating trainers are notified that it has this ability.

Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, higher-levelled Pokémon have their encounter rate increased.
effectEs: El rival gasta 2 PP por movimiento en vez de 1.

name: primordial-sea
effect:
When this Pokémon enters battle or gains this ability, the weather becomes heavy rain.  Heavy rain has all the properties of Rain Dance and also causes damaging Fire moves to fail.

Heavy rain ends when this Pokémon leaves battle or loses this ability, or when this ability is nullified.  The weather cannot otherwise be changed except by the effects of Delta Stream and Desolate Land.

Air Lock and Cloud Nine will prevent the effects of heavy rain, including allowing Fire moves to work, but will not allow the weather to be changed.
effectEs: Invoca lluvia torrencial que anula Fuego y desvanecimiento. Solo Kyogre Primigenio.

name: prism-armor
effect:
Super-effective damage this Pokémon takes is reduced to 0.75×.

This Ability is not bypassed by Mold Breaker, Teravolt, or Turboblaze.
effectEs: Reduce daño supereficaz a 3/4. Solo Necrozma.

name: propeller-tail
effect: Ignores the effects of opposing Pokémon’s Abilities and moves that draw in moves.
effectEs: Sus movimientos ignoran redirecciones como Pararrayos o Polvo Ira.

name: protean
effect:
Changes the bearer's type to match each move it uses.

The type change takes place just before the move is used.
effectEs: Cambia su tipo al del movimiento que va a usar.

name: protosynthesis
effect: Boosts the Pokémon’s most proficient stat in harsh sunlight or if the Pokémon is holding Booster Energy.
effectEs: Con sol o con Cápsula Potenciadora, sube su stat más alto.

name: psychic-surge
effect: When this Pokémon enters battle, it changes the terrain to Psychic Terrain.
effectEs: Invoca Campo Psíquico al entrar.

name: punk-rock
effect: Boosts the power of sound-based moves. The Pokémon also takes half the damage from these kinds of moves.
effectEs: Potencia movimientos de sonido 1,3× y recibe la mitad de daño de ellos.

name: pure-power
effect:
This Pokémon's Attack is doubled in battle.

This bonus does not count as a stat modifier.

This ability functions identically to Huge Power.
effectEs: Duplica su Ataque. Solo Medicham.

name: purifying-salt
effect: The Pokémon’s pure salt protects it from status conditions and halves the damage taken from Ghost-type moves.
effectEs: Inmune a estados y reduce a la mitad el daño Fantasma.

name: quark-drive
effect: Boosts the Pokémon’s most proficient stat on Electric Terrain or if the Pokémon is holding Booster Energy.
effectEs: Con Campo Eléctrico o Cápsula Potenciadora, sube su stat más alto.

name: queenly-majesty
effect: When an opposing Pokémon attempts to use a move that targets this Pokémon or an ally, and that move has priority, it will fail.
effectEs: Evita que el rival use movimientos con prioridad contra él o aliados.

name: quick-draw
effect: If a Pokémon with this Ability selects a damaging move, it has a 30% chance of going first in its priority bracket.
effectEs: 30% de moverse primero dentro de su categoría de prioridad.

name: quick-feet
effect:
Whenever this Pokémon has a major status ailment, it has 1.5× its Speed.  This Pokémon is not affected by the usual Speed cut from paralysis.

Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, the wild encounter rate is halved.
effectEs: Si tiene problema de estado, sube 1,5× su Velocidad y no pierde Velocidad por parálisis.

name: rain-dish
effect: This Pokémon heals for 1/16 of its maximum HP after each turn during rain.
effectEs: Recupera 1/16 PS por turno con lluvia.

name: rattled
effect: This Pokémon's Speed rises one stage with each hit from a damaging Dark-, Ghost-, or Bug-type move.
effectEs: Si recibe Siniestro, Bicho o Fantasma, sube un nivel su Velocidad.

name: receiver
effect: When an ally faints, this Pokémon gains its Ability.
effectEs: Copia la habilidad de un aliado debilitado.

name: reckless
effect:
This Pokémon's recoil moves and crash moves have 1.2× their base power.

Struggle is unaffected.

The "crash moves" are the moves that damage the user upon missing: Jump Kick and High Jump Kick.
effectEs: Potencia 1,2× movimientos con retroceso o que fallan.

name: refrigerate
effect: Turns the bearer's Normal-type moves into Ice-type moves.  Moves changed by this ability have 1.3× their power.
effectEs: Convierte movimientos Normal en Hielo y potencia 1,2×.

name: regenerator
effect:
This Pokémon regains 1/3 of its maximum HP when it is switched out for another Pokémon under any circumstances other than having fainted.

This ability does not take effect when a battle ends.
effectEs: Recupera 1/3 PS al salir del combate.

name: ripen
effect: Ripens Berries and doubles their effect.
effectEs: Duplica el efecto de bayas al comerlas.

name: rivalry
effect:
This Pokémon inflicts 1.25× as much regular damage against Pokémon of the same gender and 0.75× as much regular damage against Pokémon of the opposite gender.

If either Pokémon is genderless, damage is unaffected.
effectEs: Hace 1,25× daño a rivales del mismo género y 0,75× si es distinto.

name: rks-system
effect:
Changes this Pokémon's type to match its held Memory.

This ability cannot be copied, replaced, or nullified.  This ability only takes effect for Silvally.
effectEs: Cambia tipo según disco. Solo Silvally.

name: rock-head
effect:
This Pokémon does not receive recoil damage from its recoil moves.

Struggle's recoil is unaffected.  This ability does not prevent crash damage from missing with Jump Kick or High Jump Kick.
effectEs: No recibe retroceso de movimientos.

name: rocky-payload
effect: Increases the power of Rock-type moves used by this Pokémon by 50%.
effectEs: Potencia movimientos de tipo Roca 1,5×.

name: rough-skin
effect:
Whenever a move makes contact with this Pokémon, the move's user takes 1/8 of its maximum HP in damage.

This ability functions identically to Iron Barbs.
effectEs: Si le golpean por contacto, el atacante pierde 1/8 PS.

name: run-away
effect: This Pokémon is always successful fleeing from wild battles, even if trapped by a move or ability.
effectEs: Permite huir de Pokémon salvajes sin fallar.

name: sand-force
effect: During a sandstorm, this Pokémon's Rock-, Ground-, and Steel-type moves have 1.3× their base power.  This Pokémon does not take sandstorm damage, regardless of type.
effectEs: Potencia Roca, Tierra y Acero 1,3× con tormenta arena. Inmune a arena.

name: sand-rush
effect: This Pokémon's Speed is doubled during a sandstorm, and it does not take sandstorm damage, regardless of type.
effectEs: Duplica Velocidad con tormenta arena. Inmune a arena.

name: sand-spit
effect: The Pokémon creates a sandstorm when it’s hit by an attack.
effectEs: Invoca tormenta arena al ser golpeado.

name: sand-stream
effect:
The weather changes to a sandstorm when this Pokémon enters battle and does not end unless cancelled by another weather condition.

If multiple Pokémon with this ability, Drizzle, Drought, or Snow Warning are sent out at the same time, the abilities will activate in order of Speed, respecting Trick Room.  Each ability's weather will cancel the previous weather, and only the weather summoned by the slowest of the Pokémon will stay.

Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, the wild encounter rate is halved in a sandstorm.
effectEs: Invoca tormenta arena al entrar.

name: sand-veil
effect:
During a sandstorm, this Pokémon has 1.25× its evasion, and it does not take sandstorm damage regardless of type.

The evasion bonus does not count as a stat modifier.

Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, the wild encounter rate is halved in a sandstorm.
effectEs: Sube evasión 1,25× con tormenta arena. Inmune a arena.

name: sap-sipper
effect: Whenever a Grass-type move hits this Pokémon, its Attack rises one stage, negating any other effect on it.
effectEs: Inmune a Planta y sube Ataque un nivel si es golpeado por Planta.

name: schooling
effect:
If this Pokémon is a Wishiwashi and level 20 or above, then when it enters battle and at the start of each turn, it becomes Schooling Form if its HP is 25% or higher and Solo Form otherwise.

This ability cannot be replaced, copied, or nullified.
effectEs: Wishiwashi cambia a Forma Banco con más de 25% PS a nivel 20+.

name: scrappy
effect:
This Pokémon ignores Ghost-type Pokémon's immunity to Normal- and Fighting-type moves.

Ghost Pokémon's other types affect damage as usual.
effectEs: Puede golpear a Fantasma con Normal y Lucha. Inmune a intimidación.

name: screen-cleaner
effect: When the Pokémon enters a battle, the effects of Light Screen, Reflect, and Aurora Veil are nullified for both opposing and ally Pokémon.
effectEs: Al entrar elimina pantallas de luz, reflejo, velo aurora y niebla de ambos lados.

name: seed-sower
effect: Turns the ground into Grassy Terrain when the Pokémon is hit by an attack.
effectEs: Invoca Campo de Hierba al ser golpeado.

name: serene-grace
effect:
This Pokémon's moves have twice their usual effect chance.

An effect chance is a move's chance to inflict a status ailment, cause a stat change, or make the target flinch in addition to the move's main effect.  For example, Flamethrower's chance of burning the target is doubled, but Protect's chance of success and Air Cutter's increased critical hit rate are unaffected.

Secret Power is unaffected.
effectEs: Duplica la probabilidad de efectos secundarios de sus movimientos.

name: shadow-shield
effect:
When this Pokémon has full HP, regular damage (not fixed damage!) from moves is halved.

This ability cannot be nullified.
effectEs: Si tiene PS al máximo recibe la mitad de daño. Solo Lunala.

name: shadow-tag
effect:
While this Pokémon is in battle, opposing Pokémon cannot flee or switch out.

Other Pokémon with this ability are unaffected.  Pokémon with Run Away can still flee.  Pokémon can still switch out with the use of a move or item.
effectEs: Impide que el rival huya o cambie. Solo Wobbuffet y Gothitelle.

name: sharpness
effect: Increases the power of all 'slicing' moves by 50%.
effectEs: Potencia movimientos cortantes 1,5×.

name: shed-skin
effect: After each turn, this Pokémon has a 33% of being cured of any major status ailment.
effectEs: 33% de curar problemas de estado al final de cada turno.

name: sheer-force
effect:
This Pokémon's moves with extra effects have 1.3× their power, but lose their extra effects.

An effect chance is a move's chance to inflict a status ailment, cause a stat change, or make the target flinch in addition to the move's main effect. For example, Thunder Shock's paralysis is an extra effect, but Thunder Wave's is not, nor are Knock Off's item removal and Air Cutter's increased critical hit rate.

Moves that lower the user's stats are unaffected.
effectEs: Elimina efectos secundarios de sus movimientos pero potencia 1,3×.

name: shell-armor
effect:
Moves cannot score critical hits against this Pokémon.

This ability functions identically to Battle Armor.
effectEs: Evita golpes críticos.

name: shield-dust
effect:
This Pokémon is immune to the extra effects of moves used against it.

An extra effect is a move's chance, listed as an "effect chance", to inflict a status ailment, cause a stat change, or make the target flinch in addition to the move's main effect.  For example, Thunder Shock's paralysis is an extra effect, but Thunder Wave's is not, nor are Knock Off's item removal and Air Cutter's increased critical hit rate.
effectEs: Evita efectos secundarios de movimientos rivales.

name: shields-down
effect:
When this Pokémon enters battle and at the end of each turn, if its HP is 50% or above, it changes into Meteor Form; otherwise, it changes into Core Form.  In Meteor Form, it cannot be given a major status ailment (though existing ones are not cured), cannot become drowsy from Yawn, and cannot use Rest (which will simply fail).

This ability cannot be copied, replaced, or nullified.  This ability only takes effect for Minior.
effectEs: Minior cambia de forma según PS, y con menos de 50% pierde defensas pero gana ofensas.

name: simple
effect:
Each stage of this Pokémon's stat modifiers acts as two stages.  These doubled stages are still limited to a minimum of -6 and a maximum of 6.

This Pokémon can still accumulate less than -3 or more than 3 stages of stat modifiers, even though the extra ones have no effect after doubling.
effectEs: Duplica los cambios de estadísticas que recibe.

name: skill-link
effect: This Pokémon always hits five times with two-to-five-hit moves, such as Icicle Spear.  It also bypasses the accuracy checks on Triple Kick's second and third hits.
effectEs: Movimientos de golpes múltiples siempre hacen 5 golpes.

name: slow-start
effect:
This Pokémon's Attack and Speed are halved for five turns upon entering battle.

This ability also takes effect when acquired during battle.  If this Pokémon loses its ability before the five turns are up, its Attack and Speed return to normal; if it then regains this ability without leaving battle, its Attack and Speed are halved again, but the counter keeps counting from where it was.
effectEs: Durante 5 turnos su Ataque y Velocidad se reducen a la mitad. Solo Regigigas.

name: slush-rush
effect: During Hail, this Pokémon has double Speed.
effectEs: Duplica Velocidad con nieve/granizo.

name: sniper
effect: This Pokémon inflicts triple damage with critical hits, rather than the usual double damage.
effectEs: Golpes críticos hacen 2,25× en vez de 1,5×.

name: snow-cloak
effect:
During hail, this Pokémon has 1.25× its evasion, and it does not take hail damage regardless of type.

The evasion bonus does not count as a stat modifier.

Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, the wild encounter rate is halved in snow.
effectEs: Sube evasión 1,25× con granizo/nieve.

name: snow-warning
effect:
The weather changes to hail when this Pokémon enters battle and does not end unless cancelled by another weather condition.

If multiple Pokémon with this ability, Drizzle, Drought, or Sand Stream are sent out at the same time, the abilities will activate in order of Speed, respecting Trick Room.  Each ability's weather will cancel the previous weather, and only the weather summoned by the slowest of the Pokémon will stay.
effectEs: Invoca nieve al entrar.

name: solar-power
effect: During strong sunlight, this Pokémon has 1.5× its Special Attack but takes 1/8 of its maximum HP in damage after each turn.
effectEs: Con sol sube At. Esp. 1,5× pero pierde 1/8 PS por turno.

name: solid-rock
effect:
This Pokémon takes 0.75× as much damage from moves that are super effective against it.

This ability functions identically to Filter.
effectEs: Reduce daño supereficaz a 3/4.

name: soul-heart
effect: This Pokémon's Special Attack rises by one stage every time any Pokémon faints.
effectEs: Al debilitar a un rival sube un nivel su At. Esp. Solo Magearna.

name: soundproof
effect:
This Pokémon is immune to moves flagged as being sound-based.

Heal Bell is unaffected.  Uproar still prevents this Pokémon from sleeping.  This Pokémon can still receive a Perish Song counter through Baton Pass, and will retain a Perish Song counter if it acquires this ability after Perish Song is used.

Howl, Roar of Time, Sonic Boom, and Yawn are not flagged as sound-based.
effectEs: Inmune a movimientos de sonido.

name: speed-boost
effect: This Pokémon's Speed rises one stage after each turn.
effectEs: Sube un nivel su Velocidad al final de cada turno.

name: spicy-spray
effect: When the Pokémon takes damage from a move, it burns the attacker.
effectEs: Al entrar, suelta un spray picante que baja la Defensa del rival.

name: stakeout
effect: This Pokémon's moves have double power against Pokémon that switched in this turn.
effectEs: Hace el doble de daño a rivales que entran o salen en el mismo turno.

name: stall
effect:
This Pokémon moves last within its priority bracket.

Multiple Pokémon with this ability move in order of Speed amongst themselves.

The Full Incense and Lagging Tail take precedence over this ability; that is, Pokémon with these items move after Pokémon with this ability.  Pokémon with both this ability and one of these items are delayed as much as if they had only the item.

This ability works as usual during Trick Room: Pokémon with this ability will move in reverse order of Speed after Pokémon without it.
effectEs: Siempre se mueve al último dentro de su prioridad.

name: stalwart
effect: Ignores the effects of opposing Pokémon’s Abilities and moves that draw in moves.
effectEs: Ignora redirecciones de movimientos.

name: stamina
effect: Raises this Pokémon's Defense by one stage when it takes damage from a move.
effectEs: Si recibe un golpe sube un nivel su Defensa.

name: stance-change
effect: Changes Aegislash to Blade Forme before using a damaging move, or Shield Forme before using King’s Shield.
effectEs: Aegislash cambia entre forma Escudo y Filo según use movimientos defensivos u ofensivos.

name: static
effect:
Whenever a move makes contact with this Pokémon, the move's user has a 30% chance of being paralyzed.

Pokémon that are immune to Electric-type moves can still be paralyzed by this ability.

Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, there is a 50% chance that encounters will be with an Electric Pokémon, if applicable.
effectEs: 30% de paralizar al atacante por contacto.

name: steadfast
effect: Whenever this Pokémon flinches, its Speed rises one stage.
effectEs: Si retrocede por miedo sube un nivel su Velocidad.

name: steam-engine
effect: Raises the user's Speed by three stages when it is hit by a Fire- or Water-type attack. The attack still deals damage.
effectEs: Si recibe Fuego o Agua sube 6 niveles su Velocidad.

name: steelworker
effect: This Pokémon's Steel moves have 1.5× power.
effectEs: Potencia movimientos de tipo Acero 1,5×.

name: steely-spirit
effect: Powers up the Steel-type moves of the Pokémon and its allies.
effectEs: Potencia movimientos Acero de aliados 1,5×.

name: stench
effect:
This Pokémon's damaging moves have a 10% chance to make the target flinch with each hit if they do not already cause flinching as a secondary effect.

This ability does not stack with a held item.

Overworld: The wild encounter rate is halved while this Pokémon is first in the party.
effectEs: 10% de hacer retroceder al rival por daño. Duplica encuentros si lidera.

name: sticky-hold
effect:
This Pokémon's hold item cannot be removed by other Pokémon.

Damaging moves that would remove this Pokémon's item can still inflict damage against this Pokémon, e.g. Knock Off or Pluck.  This Pokémon can still use moves that involve the loss of its own item, e.g. Fling or Trick.

Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, the encounter rate while fishing is increased.
effectEs: Evita que le quiten o roben el objeto.

name: storm-drain
effect:
All other Pokémon's single-target Water-type moves are redirected to this Pokémon, if it is an eligible target.  Other Pokémon's Water moves raise this Pokémon's Special Attack one stage, negating any other effect on it, and cannot miss it.

If the move's intended target also has this ability, the move is not redirected.  When multiple Pokémon with this ability are possible targets for redirection, the move is redirected to the one with the highest Speed stat, or, in the case of a tie, to a random tied Pokémon.  Follow Me takes precedence over this ability.
effectEs: Atrae movimientos Agua, inmune a ellos y sube un nivel su At. Esp.

name: strong-jaw
effect: Strengthens biting moves to 1.5× their power.
effectEs: Potencia movimientos de mordisco 1,5×.

name: sturdy
effect:
When this Pokémon is at full HP, any hit that would knock it out will instead leave it with 1 HP.  Regardless of its current HP, it is also immune to the one-hit KO moves: Fissure, Guillotine, Horn Drill, and Sheer Cold.

If this Pokémon is holding a Focus Sash, this ability takes precedence and the item will not be consumed.
effectEs: Evita ser debilitado de un golpe si tiene PS al máximo. Inmune a KO directo.

name: suction-cups
effect:
This Pokémon cannot be forced out of battle by moves such as Whirlwind.

Dragon Tail and Circle Throw still inflict damage against this Pokémon.

Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, the success rate while fishing is increased.
effectEs: Evita cambio forzado y que le bajen estadísticas por el rival.

name: super-luck
effect: This Pokémon's moves have critical hit rates one stage higher than normal.
effectEs: Aumenta la probabilidad de crítico (ratio ×2).

name: supersweet-syrup
effect: A sickly sweet scent spreads across the field the first time the Pokémon enters a battle, lowering the evasiveness of opposing Pokémon.
effectEs: Al entrar baja un nivel la evasión del rival.

name: supreme-overlord
effect: When the Pokémon enters a battle, its Attack and Sp. Atk stats are slightly boosted for each of the allies in its party that have already been defeated.
effectEs: Potencia sus movimientos según aliados debilitados (hasta 1 + 0,1 por cada uno).

name: surge-surfer
effect: Doubles this Pokémon's Speed on Electric Terrain.
effectEs: Duplica Velocidad en Campo Eléctrico.

name: swarm
effect:
When this Pokémon has 1/3 or less of its HP remaining, its Bug-type moves inflict 1.5× as much regular damage.

Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, the wild encounter rate is increased.
effectEs: Potencia movimientos Bicho 1,5× con PS a 1/3 o menos.

name: sweet-veil
effect: Prevents friendly Pokémon from sleeping.
effectEs: Evita que él y aliados se duerman.

name: swift-swim
effect:
This Pokémon's Speed is doubled during rain.

This bonus does not count as a stat modifier.
effectEs: Duplica Velocidad con lluvia.

name: sword-of-ruin
effect: The power of the Pokémon’s ruinous sword lowers the Defense stats of all Pokémon except itself.
effectEs: Reduce Defensa de todos los demás Pokémon.

name: symbiosis
effect: Passes the bearer's held item to an ally when the ally uses up its item.
effectEs: Pasa su objeto a un aliado que haya usado su objeto.

name: synchronize
effect:
Whenever this Pokémon is burned, paralyzed, or poisoned, the Pokémon who gave this Pokémon that ailment is also given the ailment.

This ability passes back bad poison when this Pokémon is badly poisoned.  This ability cannot pass on a status ailment that the Pokémon did not directly receive from another Pokémon, such as the poison from Toxic Spikes or the burn from a Flame Orb.

Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, wild Pokémon have a 50% chance of having the lead Pokémon's nature, and a 50% chance of being given a random nature as usual, including the lead Pokémon's nature.  This does not work on Pokémon received outside of battle or roaming legendaries.
effectEs: Contagia envenenamiento, parálisis o quemadura al rival que se lo cause.

name: tablets-of-ruin
effect: The power of the Pokémon’s ruinous wooden tablets lowers the Attack stats of all Pokémon except itself.
effectEs: Reduce Ataque de todos los demás.

name: tangled-feet
effect: When this Pokémon is confused, it has twice its evasion.
effectEs: Sube evasión si está confuso.

name: tangling-hair
effect: When this Pokémon takes regular damage from a contact move, the attacking Pokémon's Speed lowers by one stage.
effectEs: Si le golpean por contacto baja un nivel la Velocidad del atacante.

name: technician
effect:
This Pokémon's moves have 1.5× their power if their base power is 60 or less.

This includes moves of variable power, such as Hidden Power and Magnitude, when their power is 60 or less.  Helping Hand's power boost is taken into account for any move, as is Defense Curl's power boost for Rollout.
effectEs: Potencia movimientos de 60 o menos potencia base a 1,5×.

name: telepathy
effect: This Pokémon does not take damage from friendly Pokémon's moves, including single-target moves aimed at it.
effectEs: Evita daño de aliados.

name: tera-shell
effect: The Pokémon’s shell contains the powers of each type. All damage-dealing moves that hit the Pokémon when its HP is full will not be very effective.
effectEs: Si tiene PS al máximo, recibe daño no muy eficaz a 1/2. Solo Terapagos.

name: tera-shift
effect: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it absorbs the energy around itself and transforms into its Terastal Form.
effectEs: Al entrar Terapagos cambia a Forma Astral.

name: teraform-zero
